title: More Than 1,000 New Billikens Arrive at SLU for Fall 2026
summary_en: There were comforters and mini-fridges. Boxes of clothes, desk lamps and family photos. And more than a few cars packed to the roof. More than 1,000 new Billikens arrived at Saint Louis University on Friday, Aug. 14, as first-year students moved into residence halls and began making the SLU campus their new home. But they didn't have to do it alone.
title_cn: More Than 1,000 New Billikens Arrive at SLU for Fall 2026
